summary: Popular, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.75 per common share, approved by its Board of Directors. The dividend is payable July 1, 2026 to shareholders of record May 29, 2026. This routine dividend declaration does not constitute a special situation under any of the defined categories, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program (beyond ordinary dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. No deal terms apply.
